caption: The drawing features a transparent, light blue glass pitcher with a single handle on its right side and a spout oriented to the left. The neck of the pitcher is adorned with three golden or amber-colored glass rings that wrap around it horizontally. The body of the pitcher is bulbous and rounded, tapering slightly at the neck. In the top left corner, there is a smaller, circular top-down view of the pitcher, highlighting the spout and handle placement, also rendered in light blue and amber tones. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, full-view image of the pitcher from a three-quarter perspective, showing its form and proportions. The background is plain and light-colored, and the objects are outlined with fine, precise lines. The drawings are contained within lightly sketched rectangular frames, and the image is signed by W. H. Shurcliff at the bottom right corner, with a caption at the bottom left reading "Left Hand Pitcher Exact-Size."
title: Cream Pitcher
